+_endpoint_context_cache: Dict[int, str] = {}

+def get_endpoint_context(dependant: Dependant, route: BaseRoute) -> Optional[str]:
+    if route is None:
+        return None
+    dependant_id = id(dependant)
+    if dependant_id in _endpoint_context_cache:
+        return _endpoint_context_cache[dependant_id]
+
+    if dependant.call is None:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        call = dependant.call
+        # Unwrap decorators
+        while hasattr(call, "__wrapped__"):
+            call = call.__wrapped__
+
+        source_file = inspect.getfile(call)
+        _, start_line = inspect.getsourcelines(call)
+        func_name = call.__name__
+
+        # Get method and path from route
+        methods = getattr(route, "methods", None)
+        if methods:
+            method_str = "/".join(sorted(methods))
+        else:
+            method_str = "UNKNOWN"
+
+        path = getattr(route, "path", "UNKNOWN")
+
+        context = f"File \"{source_file}\", line {start_line}, in {func_name}\n    {method_str} {path}"
+        _endpoint_context_cache[dependant_id] = context
+        return context
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
